interpretation_zh: 主LM完整200步未通过0.005；baseline和独立continuous400前200步给出相同差异。
三个run的输入全局摘要、四项计数、CPU构造初态及runtime flags一致，不能据此排除分片后/device内部状态或算子数值差异。
逐rank日志为全局标量；1600项覆盖核验不是8份独立局部loss观测。
首步前向loss已有差异，单靠后续优化器更新不能解释首步差异；具体函数及根因未定位。
正式性能按每步8rank最大callback时间，排除前20步；strict中rank0性能不用于正式比较。
TP4对应DP2、4微批；分片/激活范围与通信不同，不能预言4倍速度或显存降至四分之一。
TP4 rank0初始布局元素数由本次原文件重新计算；optimizer state初始为空，不能据此测量最终momentum或完整持久显存。
显存为allocator生命周期峰值，含warmup/回调，不是物理HBM峰值；单次共享机观测且精度失败，仅作诊断，不推荐为已验收优化。
limitations: No actual global state or active CP2 process was accessed.
Historical baseline/continuous receipts lack explicit container_stopped; full release/idle evidence remains. Candidate additionally has stopped=true and independent exact-CID absence.
MTP/aux unweighted diagnostics derive from weighted scalar differences; no separately captured pre-multiplication tensors or matrix-wide acceptance.
No root-cause attribution to a PR or function is established.

loss_units.derived: absolute logged scalar gap divided by recorded coefficient; not separately captured pre-multiplication tensors
